verdict.rationale: Vercel's first-party docs say sandboxes run untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs, without exposing production systems. Support for system-privileged workloads such as Docker, VPN clients and FUSE is consistent with VM-level rather than container-level isolation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the isolation architecture (hypervisor, network/egress boundaries, threat model), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the boundary holds.
